---

## 1. **Dependabot Ignore Configuration**

If you're using **Dependabot** (GitHub-native), you can tell it to ignore specific package versions by editing your `.github/dependabot.yml`.

### Example:

```yaml
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "npm"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
    ignore:
      - dependency-name: "asciidoctor.js"
        versions:
          - "3.0.9"
          - "5.0.0"
```

---

## 2. **Why Tests Might Fail with deglob and Newer asciidoctor.js?**

- Major versions (`3.0.9`, `5.0.0`) of asciidoctor.js likely include **breaking changes** or dropped APIs.
- `deglob` or test code might rely on methods that have changed or moved.
- If you intend to support newer asciidoctor.js in the future, you’ll need to update your codebase to be compatible.

---

## 3. **Workflow**

- By adding the `ignore` entry, Dependabot PRs for `asciidoctor.js` won't include these versions.
- Your `deglob`-related tests should remain green until you’re ready for the upgrade.

---

## 4. **Extra: Locally Reproducing Issues**

To debug further:
1. Try installing these versions one at a time:
   ```sh
   npm install asciidoctor.js@3.0.9
   npm test
   # then
   npm install asciidoctor.js@5.0.0
   npm test
   ```
2. Observe specific error messages; it may help decide when/how to address the upgrade and pinpoint what to fix.

---

### **Summary**

- Adding to `.github/dependabot.yml` as above will ignore unwanted versions.
- Test failures with `deglob` probably come from incompatibility.
- You can revisit later when upstream issues are resolved or your code is ready for the new `asciidoctor.js` API.

<blockquote>
<h2>v6.0.0</h2>
<h2><a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/compare/v5.5.0...v6.0.0">v6.0.0</a> (2021-02-02)</h2>
<h3>⚠ BREAKING CHANGES</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>chromium:</strong> The built-in <code>aria/</code> selector query handler doesn’t return ignored elements anymore.</li>
<li><strong>typescript:</strong> Puppeteer now ships with built-in TypeScript definitions. This means you no longer need to install <code>@types/puppeteer</code>. We are aware that there are likely improvements that can be made to our types to improve the developer experience when using them; please open issues if you hit any problems with the built-in TS definitions, or notice areas where you feel types are lacking.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>chromium:</strong> roll Chromium to r843427 (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6797">#6797</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/8f9fbdbae68254600a9c73ab05f36146c975dba6">8f9fbdb</a>), closes <a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6758">#6758</a></li>
<li>add page.emulateNetworkConditions (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6759">#6759</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/5ea76e9333c42ab5a751ca01aa5676a662f6c063">5ea76e9</a>)</li>
<li><strong>types:</strong> expose typedefs to consumers (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6745">#6745</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/ebd087a31661a1b701650d0be3e123cc5a813bd8">ebd087a</a>)</li>
<li>add iPhone 11 models to DeviceDescriptors (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6467">#6467</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/50b810dab7fae5950ba086295462788f91ff1e6f">50b810d</a>)</li>
<li>support fetching and launching on Apple M1 (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/9a8479a52a7d8b51690b0732b2a10816cd1b8aef">9a8479a</a>), closes <a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6495">#6495</a> <a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6634">#6634</a> <a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6641">#6641</a> <a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6614">#6614</a></li>
<li>support promise as return value for page.waitForResponse predicate (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6624">#6624</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/b57f3fcd5393c68f51d82e670b004f5b116dcbc3">b57f3fc</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>domworld:</strong> fix waitfor bindings (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6766">#6766</a>) (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6775">#6775</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/cac540be3ab8799a1d77b0951b16bc22ea1c2adb">cac540b</a>)</li>
<li><strong>launcher:</strong> rename TranslateUI to Translate to match Chrome (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6692">#6692</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/d901696e0d8901bcb23cf676a5e5ac562f821a0d">d901696</a>)</li>
<li>do not use old utility world (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6528">#6528</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/fb859115c0e2829bae1d1b32edbf642988e2ef76">fb85911</a>), closes <a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6527">#6527</a></li>
<li>update to https-proxy-agent@^5.0.0 to fix <code>ERR_INVALID_PROTOCOL</code> (<a href="https://github-redirect.dependabot.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/6555">#6555</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/commit/3bf5a552890ee80cc4326b1e430424b0fdad4363">3bf5a55</a>)</li>
</ul>

# `node-ignore` 5 ChangeLog

# 5.x

## 2018-08-13, Version 5.0.0

- **SEMVER-MAJOR**: [#20](https://github.com/kaelzhang/node-ignore/issues/20): it will throw if an invalid pathname passes into `.ignores(pathname)`, see [Upgrade 4.x -> 5.x](https://github.com/kaelzhang/node-ignore#upgrade-4x---5x).
- **FEATURE**: [#31](https://github.com/kaelzhang/node-ignore/issues/31): adds a new method [`.test(pathname)`](https://github.com/kaelzhang/node-ignore#testpathname-pathname-since-500).
- **BENCHMARK**: improves performance by 26%.

# 4.x

## 2018-08-12, Version 4.0.6

- **PATCH**: `Object.prototype` methods will not ruin the result any more.

## ~ 2018-08-09, Version 4.0.1 - 4.0.5

- **PATCH**: updates README.md about frequent asked quesions from github issues.

## 2018-06-22, Version 4.0.0

- **SEMVER-MAJOR**: Drop support for node < 6 by default.
- **FEATURE**: supports the missing character ranges and sets, such as `*.[a-z]` and `*.[jJ][pP][gG]`
- **FEATURE**: new option: `ignorecase` to make `ignore` case sensitive.
- **FEATURE**: supports question mark which matches a single character.
- **PATCH**: fixes typescript declaration.
